5:         if message['key'] in visited:
6:             continue
7:         visited.add(message['key'])
8:         if message['kind'] == 'post':
9:             bucket, delta = message['bucket'], message['delta']
10:             entries[message['key']] = (bucket, delta)
11:             positions.setdefault(bucket, 0)
12:             if True:
13:                 positions[bucket] += delta
14:         else:
15:             reference = message['reference']
16:             if reference in voided:
17:                 continue
18:             voided.add(reference)
19:             if reference in entries:
20:                 bucket, delta = entries[reference]
21:                 positions[bucket] -= delta
22:     return positions
